## Experience quality

- [ ] Every new or changed page, route state, and material non-route surface is represented in `experience/registry.json`.
- [ ] `npm run experience:self-test` proves a deliberately unregistered route is rejected.
- [ ] `npm run experience:validate` passes without obsolete sources or unreviewed materiality drift.
- [ ] Required empty, loading, error, success, restricted, dense, long-content, reduced-motion, and keyboard-only states were reviewed where applicable.
- [ ] Mobile (390), tablet (768), desktop (1280), and wide (1440) behavior was reviewed where applicable.
- [ ] Keyboard focus, semantics, contrast, and reduced-motion behavior were verified.
- [ ] Screenshot, fixture, and accessibility coverage fields accurately describe the evidence attached to this PR.
- [ ] Signal Review or UX QA findings are linked, resolved, or recorded as an owned, expiring exception.
- [ ] The change preserves Signal's briefing-first product model and does not introduce dashboard or score chrome.

## Evidence

Describe the routes, states, breakpoints, commands, screenshots, review records, and intentional exceptions covered by this change.
